expected.description: An inherited SHELLOPTS with noexec (or onecmd) takes effect before push-guard.sh's restart line, so the guard exits 0 having checked nothing, and its callers read that as safe to push.

The restart test in push-guard.sh greps the env output with no once-only guard, so an environment value holding a newline followed by BASHOPTS= or SHELLOPTS= (or GREP_OPTIONS=-v) makes the guard re-exec itself forever.
